notablePrerequisites:
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Warchanter Skald.
description:
Cast Lightning Volley by paying {3}{R}.
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Resolve the Warchanter Skald ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dwarf Berserker, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat from step 2.
